commit_role: package tree this file describes; this manifest is added in the child commit
asset_hash: sha256 of the git blob bytes (LF)

metric_provenance.published_numbers_recomputed_after_filte: false: the numbers at metrics_commit were not recomputed on filter_commit or on package_tree_commit

roles.head_commit: Parent of the commit that writes this block. The file cannot store the hash of the commit that introduces the block. f6a21e9 is an ancestor, not the cloneable tree.
roles.runtime_tree_commit: Last commit that changed the filter. Equals package_tree_commit and filter_commit.
roles.manifest_commit: Same parent as head_commit. Not the asset pin and not f6a21e9.
roles.asset_pin_commit: Equals commit. Asset sha256 are git blobs at this commit, not at head_commit.
roles.metrics_commit: Published numbers. Not valid for head_commit or runtime_tree_commit.
roles.evaluator_commit: No single evaluator. A row carries evaluator_sha256 only when those file bytes were stored.
roles.bag_sha256: null on every row: bag bytes were not hashed and are not reconstructed
roles.params_sha256: null on every row: not stored with the run. Current params.yaml is tree_sha256, not a run record.
roles.assets_sha256: null on every row: not one digest of that run. Current asset digests are the assets object at asset_pin_commit.
roles.timestamp: null on every row: same rule as date
roles.docker_image_digest: filled only where the run stored it; otherwise null
roles.command: filled only where the run stored it; otherwise null
